notes.title: Artbook, Comic Book and Deluxe Edition
notes.content:
[h1]Superfluous Returnz Artbook[/h1]

I've been working on it for several weeks now, and it's finally finished: the [i]Superfluous Riteurnz Artbook[/i]!

You'll find every location, every character, every cutscene, every animation detailed frame by frame, and much more. All with my commentary, in English and French!

This book is available:
[list]
[*] in printed version on [url=https://www.lulu.com/shop/gee/superfluous-returnz-artbook/paperback/product-yv79q4d.html]Lulu[/url] and [url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/2493727185]Amazon[/url];
[*] as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445100/]a DLC (with the comic book) [/url] for the digital version.
[/list]

[h1]Superfluous, the Comic Book[/h1]

This was another job I'd been wanting to do for a long time: translating the French comic book  [url=https://editions.ptilouk.net/superflu][i]Les aventures inutiles de Superflu[/i][/url] into English.

The translation is called [url=https://editions.ptilouk.net/superfluous][i]The Unnecessary Adventures of Superfluous[/i][/url], and you can see it as a sort of “prequel” to the game: how Harpagon Lonion became Superfluous, how Sophie came to work for him, etc.

You don't have to read it to understand the game, but it's a nice bonus.

This book is available:
[list]
[*] in printed version on on [url=https://www.lulu.com/fr/shop/gee/the-unnecessary-adventures-of-superfluous/paperback/product-m2dg2vn.html]Lulu[/url] and [url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/2493727177]Amazon[/url];
[*] as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445100/]a DLC (with the artbook) [/url] for the digital version.
[/list]

[h1]Superfluous Returnz Deluxe[/h1]

Don't get carried away: there's nothing new in the game!

This [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35873][b]“Deluxe” edition[/b][/url] is simply a Steam bundle that contains:

[list]
[*] the video game Superfluous Returnz ;
[*] the “Artbook & Comic Book” DLC;
[*] the “Soundtrack” DLC.
[/list]

In short, everything you can buy on Steam, with a small 10% discount.

See you soon for new adventures!
